description: ModelComparison ParticleNet config for MHc130_MA90 with conv widths 512-256-256, edge dropout disabled, initLR 3e-4, and CyclicLR

training_parameters.comment: Weighted CE only. CyclicLR uses base_lr=initLR/5 and max_lr=initLR*2 in TrainingUtilities.

disco_parameters.comment: No DisCo term for this discrimination-only scheduler test.

model_config.comment: conv_channels are the three DynamicEdgeConv output widths. Dense head width follows the final EdgeConv width.

optimization_config.comment: Scheduler-only test relative to the 3e-4 ReduceLROnPlateau run.

background_config.comment: mode: 'groups' for physics-motivated grouping, 'individual' for each background as separate class.

dataset_config.comment: B-jets are separate particles (no btagScore). Dataset includes mass1, mass2 for decorrelation.
